Terms and Conditions

1. GENERAL INFORMATION

  1. Welcome to the FRONTIER Miles Program (“FRONTIER Miles” or “Program”). FRONTIER Miles is a member rewards program offered by Frontier Airlines (“Frontier”) that allows Frontier passengers to earn and use Travel Miles (“Miles” or “Mile”) and Elite Status Points (“Points”), in accordance with the Terms and Conditions outlined below. These Terms and Conditions (“Program Rules” or “Rules”) apply to the Program. By gaining access to or enrolling in FRONTIER Miles, you agree to be bound by these Program Rules along with the Frontier Airlines Legal Terms, including, without limitation, the Contract of Carriage and Terms of Use, which can be found at www.flyfrontier.com/legal. Frontier reserves the right to change or cancel these Program Rules, in whole or in part, at any time, in its sole discretion and without notice to you by posting updated text on this site. Please review these Rules periodically to ensure you are aware of any changes and are familiar with the most current version. For clarity, any such change to or cancellation of these Program Rules will apply to all FRONTIER Miles Members ("Members"), even those who enrolled before the Program made such a change or cancellation.

2. MEMBERSHIP/PROGRAM REGISTRATION

  1. FRONTIER Miles is a paperless, electronic customer loyalty program. Register online or use Chat With Us now. 
  2. Membership in the Program is open to any individual person, in any country that has not prohibited participation in frequent flyer programs. Other entities or parties, including but not limited to, corporations, animals, travel agencies, etc. are not eligible to enroll as members or earn Miles/Points or receive any benefits in connection with the Program.  **Per the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), children aged 13 years or younger require parental consent to participate in the FRONTIER Miles program.  Further, parental permission may be revoked at any time requiring that no new information is collected on that child without further parental consent. 
  3. Members may only have one FRONTIER Miles account. In cases where a single Member holds two accounts, one account will be closed, and eligible Miles will be transferred to the remaining active account. Some Travel Miles and Elite Status Points are not eligible to transfer, including but not limited to enrollment bonuses (if such a bonus exists) or duplicate transactions. Members who create additional accounts to circumvent promotional terms and conditions or these Rules may be subject to actions found in Section 20 of these Rules. 
  4. FRONTIER Miles accounts are non-transferable.
  5. Each Member must provide a first name, last name, date of birth, address, telephone number and a valid and individual e-mail address to register and enroll in FRONTIER Miles. For login purposes, Members may not share an email address; each Member, including minors, must provide a unique email for login purposes. Each Member must create the Member’s own account; Members or agencies are not permitted to create accounts on behalf of other individuals (except for parents or guardians of minors). Requests for name changes may require supporting legal documentation (marriage, divorce decree or legal name change documentation). Member is responsible for reporting any changes to legal name, address, telephone number, or email addresses. 
  6. While Frontier may issue monthly electronic statements for FRONTIER Miles accounts, each Member is responsible for remaining knowledgeable about account information, including, but not limited to, accumulated Miles/Points, redeemed Miles, scheduled expirations and these Program Rules. A Member’s account information can be found on the Profile Page, by signing into FRONTIER Miles. 
  7. By enrolling in FRONTIER Miles, Member expressly authorizes Frontier the use of any stored contact information for marketing and communication purposes.

3. ACCRUING/EARNING FRONTIER MILES

  1. Effective January 9, 2024, Members may earn Miles and/or Points in the following ways only: (1) making an eligible Frontier purchase and completing the associated flight; (2) participating in programs with Frontier Miles partners as described below; (3) using the Frontier Airlines World Mastercard issued by Barclays Bank, the Frontier Airlines Access Mastercard, or the Frontier Airlines Business Mastercard issued by Barclays Bank through special offers. Miles and points for eligible flight purchases will be allocated to a Member’s Frontier Miles account, regardless of the purchaser of a flight booking. Each Member’s Frontier Miles number must be included in a booking for the Member to earn Miles/Points for that Frontier flight.
  2. Effective January 9, 2024, Members will accrue ten (10) Miles and ten (10) Points per U.S. Dollar (USD) spent on eligible purchases for completed flights.
  3. Effective September 1, 2026, Members will accrue miles and points per U.S. Dollar (USD) spent on eligible purchases as shown in the chart(s) below, for completed flights. Cardmembers with a Frontier Airlines World Mastercard, Frontier Airlines Access Mastercard, or Frontier Airlines Business Mastercard, as well as Elite Status members, earn miles and points at higher rates, as shown below.

Completed flights must be made on Frontier flights (flight numbers that include the “F9” airline code); Codeshare flights will not accumulate miles or points.

  4. Programs with FRONTIER Miles Partners: Members must provide their FRONTIER Miles number to the Partner at the time of rental or Reservation. For past date credit, you must contact the Partner directly. Although FRONTIER Miles allows retroactive credit up to 180 days, Members must agree to the individual Partner’s terms and conditions for retroactive accruals. Regardless of Partners’ terms and conditions, retroactive accruals can never exceed 180 days.
  5. Frontier Airlines World Mastercard and Business Mastercard from Barclays: Miles and Points for purchases accrue in several ways based on card type. Please see your Barclays cardholder agreement for earning Terms and Conditions. Terms and conditions are subject to change without notice.
  6. Special offers and/or programs with FRONTIER Miles partners: Frontier may, in its sole discretion, periodically offer Members the opportunity to earn additional Miles and/or Points through the purchase of other Frontier Airlines products. Products may include flight incentives or other Frontier ancillary products or services, bonus offers and/or offers in connection with FRONTIER Miles Partners. These offers may be temporary in nature. Frontier reserves the right to modify or eliminate such offers at any time. These offers are void where prohibited by law. The number of Miles and/or Points offered is subject to Frontier's sole discretion. All special offers involving Miles/Points, or the Program are subject to these Program Rules. In addition to these Program Rules, FRONTIER Miles partners may have special terms and conditions that provide additional rules for the earning, transferring, accumulating, and redeeming of Miles and/or Points. Miles partners are independent entities and are not agents, employees, or subcontractors of Frontier, and Frontier is not responsible for their acts or omissions (including, without limitation, their solicitation efforts) or any products or services supplied by them (including, without limitation, the nature or quality of their products or services).
  7. Some delay may occur between eligible transactions and the posting of Miles and/or Points to your FRONTIER Miles account.
  8. To receive Miles and/or Points for eligible activities, the Member name and FRONTIER Miles account number provided in connection with the reservation or purchase must exactly match the Member name and FRONTIER Miles account number registered with Frontier. For example, and without in any way limiting the generality of the foregoing, for a flight purchase, the name associated with the FRONTIER Miles account number provided for that flight purchase must exactly match the name of the traveler. Any discrepancy may delay or void receipt of Miles/Points.
  9. To receive Miles and/or Points for Frontier purchases, Members must provide their FRONTIER Miles Membership number at the time of purchase through Flyfrontier.com or the Frontier mobile app. In the event FRONTIER Miles account numbers cannot be attached at the time of purchase, Members may apply to receive Miles/Points retroactively, as described below. Frontier reserves the right to make exceptions to this rule at its discretion.
  10. A Member may request retroactive accrual at Flyfrontier.com by signing into their account and selecting the “Add Trip” button on their Profile Page or by contacting our FRONTIER Miles team. Chat With Us.
  11. Any claim for un-credited Miles/Points must be received by Frontier within six months (180 days) after the Miles/Points were earned from a qualifying purchase. You are responsible for ensuring that Miles/Point earned are properly credited to your FRONTIER Miles account. If you believe that Miles/Points have been earned but not properly credited, you may be required to submit documentation or other proof satisfactory to Frontier, which may include, without limitation, copies of boarding passes and receipts.
  12. Miles/Points may take 48-72 hours to credit to a Member’s account.
  13. Miles/Points will not be awarded on unused, cancelled, forfeited, refunded or fraudulent travel bookings or purchases or activities, as determined by Frontier in its sole discretion.
  14. Frontier reserves the right to offer incentive bonuses to Members who book travel online through Flyfrontier.com.
  15. The activities and/or transactions eligible for earning Miles/Points, and/or the number of Miles/Points available to be accrued, are subject to change by Frontier, at any time, without notice or liability.

4. REDEMPTION OF MILES FOR FRONTIER AIRLINES AWARD TRAVEL AND BUNDLES

  1. You may redeem Travel Miles for the base fare of a Frontier-operated and marketed flight ("Award Flight"). In addition to base airfare, Travel Miles can also be redeemed for bundled travel packages ("Award Bundles"), which include popular travel benefits such as seat selection, baggage allowances, and flight flexibility. 
  2. Miles may not be redeemed for any product or service except as expressly permitted by Frontier Airlines. 
  3. Reservations for Award Travel, including Award Flights and Award Bundles, must be made directly with Frontier via FlyFrontier.com or the "Chat With Us" feature. There is no booking charge for Award Travel redemptions made on FlyFrontier.com, but a Reservation Service charge applies to Award Travel booked via the Reservations Center. 
  4. Award Travel, including Award Flights and Award Bundles, may be booked approximately eight (8) months in advance or as the flight schedule permits. 
  5. Award Travel is subject to applicable taxes and fees, starting at $5.60, which must be paid in cash or by credit card at the time of booking. 
  6. Upon confirming an Award Travel booking, the appropriate Miles will automatically be deducted from the Member’s account and/or Family Pool.
  7. Any changes to Award Travel bookings must be made by Frontier. Chat With Us now.  
  8. Award Travel may only be issued by Frontier. Program partners and/or travel agents are not authorized to issue Award Travel. 
  9. Award Travel is only issued for published routings, and destinations offered by Frontier. However, not all routes may be available for Award Travel.  
  10. All Award Travel must have confirmed reservations on all legs/segments; no open tickets are issued.  
  11. All Award Travel is subject to availability. Seats and bundles may not be available on all flights or all days. Availability depends on factors such as demand, travel date, season, destination, and other operational considerations. 
  12. Where applicable and permitted by law, any taxes, fees, and governmental or airline surcharges (such as fuel) remain the responsibility of the Member and must be paid with a credit card at the time of reservation.  
  13. Award Travel will be issued in the form of an e-ticket.  
  14. Stopovers (overnight stays at connecting cities) are not permitted for Award travel.  
  15. Award Flights do not include advance seat assignments, carry-on baggage, checked baggage or other ancillary products unless otherwise stated.  
  16. Travel Miles can be redeemed for Award Bundles, which combine travel benefits such as seat selection, baggage allowances, early boarding, and flight flexibility. Award Bundles cannot be split, modified, or purchased à la carte with Miles. 
  17. Award redemption fees paid at the time of reservation are non-refundable.  
  18. Flights purchased with a monetary payment may not be exchanged or refunded for payment with Miles, in whole or in part.  
  19. Frontier reserves the right to revise, amend, modify or discontinue the products or services for which Members may use Miles (in whole or in part) and/or the number of Miles required to redeem any product or service (including but not limited to Award tickets) in connection with the Program.  
  20. Frontier’s Flight Terms and Conditions (including but not limited to change/cancellation policies and fees) apply to Award Flights. In the event a Member cancels Award travel, Miles will be re-deposited to the original Member's Account (redeposit fees may apply). Miles used to purchase the Award Flight will be automatically forfeited if a Member does not cancel prior to scheduled departure.  
  21. Air travel on Frontier (including Award Flights) is governed by Frontier’s Contract of Carriage. Please review the Ticket Terms and Conditions and Contract of Carriage for travel requirements and restrictions, liability and baggage limitations, and requirements for the travel of minor children. Visit our baggage information page for additional requirements and restrictions. Frontier’s Customer Service Plan and Contingency Plan for Lengthy Tarmac Delays also apply to flights operated by Frontier. For clarity, these provisions only apply to the extent applicable for flights operated by Frontier.  
  22. For domestic and international travel, customers must present government-issued photo identification. For international travel, please contact the relevant embassy or consulate for details on travel documentation requirements. It is your responsibility to verify your flight information and follow Frontier’s recommended check-in times listed on the airport information page. Failure to do so may result in the loss of your seat to another customer and/or denied boarding.

5. MILES EXPIRATION

  1. Miles in a Member’s account do not expire so long as the Member generates accrual activity every twelve months; this includes any purchase activity on the Frontier Airlines World Mastercard. Unredeemed mileage accumulated in your account will expire at the end of the twelve-month period after your last accrual activity date. Other account activity, such as redeeming or other miscellaneous adjustments, will not extend your expiration date. 
  2. Miles for Frontier Airlines World Mastercard cardmembers do not expire as long as their credit card account remains active and in good standing.  
  3. Although not required, Frontier may send notifications to remind Members of upcoming expirations. To receive these notifications, Members must be “opted in” to Frontier’s email correspondence. 
  4. Expired Miles will not be reversed as a result of not receiving such notification.  

Back To Top

6. EARNING EXCLUSIONS

  1. The following fare, payment, and/or passenger categories are excluded from earning Miles and Points in the Program (though any additional services purchased by a Member in connection with any such travel will earn Miles and Points). 
  2. Tickets issued under trade and barter agreements with Frontier. 
  3. Refunded, forfeited, and unused tickets. 
  4. Free car rentals, hotel stays, or any other free service provided by a Program partner. 
  5. Any Person traveling on airline passes and/or industry or agency discount tickets, including, but not limited to airlines staff and travel agent tickets. 
  6. Tickets purchased for additional seats to carry excess baggage (i.e.; fragile items, musical instruments, medical or other equipment, etc.), pets, or to provide extra space for the passenger.

7. TERMINATION OF MEMBERSHIP

  1. Participation in the FRONTIER Miles program is voluntary. Members may choose to close their account at any time. 
  2. Membership in the Program may be terminated if the Member: 
    1. Fails to comply with these Program Rules.
    2. Misrepresents any material information (e.g. receipts).
    3. Acts in an untoward manner, displays harassing behavior or any refuses to follow an Frontier representative’s instructions.
  3. In the event of termination of Membership, any accrued Miles and Points will be forfeited.

9. MEMBER STATUS

  1. Travel Miles – Definition:
    1. Travel Miles are all Miles accrued in an account either by making eligible Frontier purchases, using your Frontier Airlines World Mastercard, earning Miles with a Frontier travel partner or Miles purchased using our mileage partner Points.com. Travel Miles may also include incentive or bonus miles either with Frontier Airlines or one of its published partners. Travel Miles do not qualify members for Elite Status.
  2. Elite Status Points – Definition:
    1. Elite Status Points are any points that are accumulated by making eligible Frontier purchases or using your Frontier Airlines World Mastercard. Elite Status Points are not associated with any promotional Miles, adjustments, Miles earned with other travel partners, purchased Miles from Points.com or mileage bonuses issued based on current status, unless explicitly stated. For information on accumulation rates on your Frontier Airlines World Mastercard account, please see your cardholder agreement provided with your credit card.
  3. Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond Status
    1. Effective January 9, 2024, Members must accrue 10,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Silver Status; Members must accrue 20,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Gold Status; Members must accrue 50,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Platinum Status; and Members must accrue 100,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Diamond Status. Members who do not accrue enough Status Level Points in a calendar year to earn Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Diamond Status do not have Elite Status within the FRONTIER Miles program. A “calendar year” is defined as between January 1 through December 31 of each year.
    2. Effective August 27, 2026, Members must accrue 75,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Diamond Status.
    3. Effective January 1, 2027, Members must accrue 15,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Silver Status; Members must accrue 25,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Gold Status; Members must accrue 50,000 Elite Status Points in a calendar year to earn Platinum Status.

    2. No Change/Cancel Fee for the Member and up to eight (8) other Members traveling on the same reservation with the same confirmation number. Modifications must be made 7+ days prior to departure. Changes to your itinerary are subject to any difference in fare and options prices.

  5. Effective January 1, 2027, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond Status Members receive:

    10. COMPANION TRAVEL

    a. Definitions

    1. Companion: A designated Frontier Miles member traveling on the same ticket as the Companion Travel Holder.

    2. Companion Travel Holder: An individual who holds Elite Platinum Status or Elite Diamond Status and is entitled to the Companion Travel benefits.

    3. Companion Travel: A benefit allowing the Companion Travel Holder to bring a designated Frontier Miles member on the same flight for the cost of government taxes and fees (starting at $5.60).

    b. Eligibility

    1. Companion travel is a FRONTIER Miles benefit exclusively available to members holding Elite Platinum Status or Elite Diamond Status.

    2. To achieve Elite Platinum Status, members must accrue 50,000 Elite Status Points within a calendar year (20,000 Elite Status Points by April 30, 2025 only through this promotion).

    3. To achieve Elite Diamond Status, members must accrue 100,000 Elite Status Points within a calendar year.

    c. Companion travel benefits

    1. Eligible members can bring a companion on an unlimited number of bookings for the cost of government taxes and fees (starting at $5.60), provided the companion:

    ➣ Has a FRONTIER Miles℠ account number.

    ➣ Is added at the time of initial booking within the same ticket.

    2. The companion travel benefit is valid for as long as the holder maintains Elite Platinum or Elite Diamond Status.

    3. There is no limit on the number of times the companion travel benefit can be used.

    4. This benefit will automatically apply to a secondary qualifying person added to the PNR at the time of booking. If there are multiple people on the PNR, the Companion Travel benefit will apply to the person with the lowest level of status.

    Booking Requirements

    • Members must be logged into their FRONTIER Miles℠ account at the start of booking to ensure the Companion Travel benefit applies.

    • The name of the companion must differ from that of the companion travel holder. Companion travel benefits cannot be used to book multiple seats under the same name for personal use or additional space.

    Additional Information

    • The companion will not earn any Travel Miles or Elite Status Points for the value of the flight.

    • All other ticket terms and conditions apply.

    • Companion travel is not permitted on GoWild! bookings.

    By using the Companion Travel benefit, you agree to these terms and conditions. Please ensure you meet all eligibility requirements prior to booking. No Shows are subject to the terms set forth in Frontier’s Contract of Carriage. Eligible members or Companions who repeatedly book and no-show flights, or who otherwise violate the terms and conditions contained in these Rules, are subject to financial penalties up to and including the revocation of companion privileges. This applies to both eligible members and companions.

    11. COMPANION CERTIFICATE

    a. Definitions

    With a companion certificate, you can bring a companion on one eligible round-trip booking for the cost of government taxes and fees (starting at $15.60), provided the companion:

    • Has a FRONTIER Miles℠ account number.

    • Is added at the time of initial booking within the same ticket.

    Blackout Dates

    Companion certificate usage is subject to blackout periods:

    12. FRONTIER MILES – FAMILY POOLING

    A FAMILY ACCOUNT POOL CAN CONSIST OF ONE (1) PRIMARY ACCOUNT HOLDER AND UP TO EIGHT (8) POOL CONTRIBUTORS. THE PRIMARY ACCOUNT HOLDER (THE PERSON WHO STARTS THE ACCOUNT POOL) MUST BE A FRONTIER AIRLINES WORLD MASTERCARD HOLDER OR ANY ELITE TIER STATUS, AND WILL CONTROL THE POOL. THE PRIMARY ACCOUNT HOLDER CAN REDEEM MILES FROM THE FAMILY POOLING ACCOUNT WITHOUT THE PERMISSION OF THE POOL CONTRIBUTORS. THE PRIMARY ACCOUNT HOLDER MAY REMOVE ANY PERSON FROM THE FAMILY POOLING ACCOUNT AT ANY TIME. POOL CONTRIBUTORS CAN BE ANY MILES CONTRIBUTOR. 

    1. Frontier Airlines assumes no responsibility for any decisions made by the Primary Account holder. 
    2. Upon accepting an invitation to join a Family Pool, all Miles in your FRONTIER Miles account become available for use by the Primary Account holder. 
    3. Any redemptions made against mileage balances after accepting the Family Pool invitation will be subject to the applicable redemption terms and conditions. 
    4. Family Pooling contributors can cancel their participation in Family Pooling at any time on their Frontier Miles Member profile page. 
    5. Upon cancellation of a Family Pool, unused Miles balances will go back to the individual FRONTIER Miles account holder who earned such Miles. 
    6. All mileage redemption balances are redeemed on a first in/first out basis from all combined pooled accounts, which may affect your balance if you choose to leave a Family Pool. Upon choosing to leave a Family Pool, your account will enter a 90 day “cooling off” period in which your account may not enter any previous pools or join or create additional pools.
    7. Upon choosing to leave a Family Pool, your account will enter a 90 day “cooling off” period in which your account may not enter any previous pools or join or create additional pools. 
    8. Although a Family Pool allows for combined balances for redeeming, expiration dates are calculated based on a single contributor’s accrual history with the exception that contributors under the age of 18 will be granted an expiration based upon the Primary Account holder’s expiration date.
    9. If at any time an individual contributor does not have accrual activity within the 12 Month expiration policy, that contributor’s Miles will expire and no longer be available for redemption by the pool or individually.
